cli.root.short: Switch Claude Desktop accounts and manage your Claude Code chats
cli.root.long:
Switch Claude Desktop between saved accounts without signing in again,
and manage the Code-tab chats of every account. Run it without a
command to open the app.

Exit codes: 0 done · 1 error · 2 wrong usage · 3 refused by a safety check
· 4 not found · 5 cancelled
cli.example.save: Save the signed-in account, then add another
cli.example.copy: Copy a chat to another account
cli.flag.no-launch: leave Claude Desktop closed after a change
cli.flag.rtl: right-to-left chat titles: auto, app, terminal or off
cli.flag.theme: colours: auto, dark, light, contrast or plain
cli.flag.force-quit: close Claude Desktop for you instead of waiting
cli.flag.replace: replace a profile saved from another account
cli.flag.lost: show chats that are on disk but in no chat list
cli.flag.limit: show at most this many chats
cli.flag.from: chat list to take the chats from
cli.flag.to: chat list to put the chats in
cli.flag.rescue-to: chat list to put the chats in (default: the signed-in account's)
cli.flag.output: file to write, or - for the terminal
cli.cmd.list: Show saved accounts and chat lists

cli.cmd.usage: Show token usage by model and project

cli.cmd.completion: Set up tab completion for your shell
